verdict.rationale: Docs confirm per-transaction chargeback splitting instructions tied to sub-merchants (docs-10) and three configurable ways to handle chargebacks (docs-11), plus webhooks for async status updates (docs-13) that could feed balance updates. However, there's no explicit evidence of a dedicated dispute-evidence submission workflow (API or dashboard) or confirmation that dispute outcomes automatically flow back into seller balances beyond generic split/chargeback allocation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence-submission API/dashboard flow for disputes, documented automatic balance reconciliation post-dispute-outcome, and independent/hands-on confirmation of per-seller dispute routing.
